text_block_list.text:
My three years of challenges with Mejiro Dober
have finally come to an end—

She achieved solid results in the Twinkle Series,
etching her name into history.

Yet she will not halt her steps.
To shine even brighter, today once again—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
—Phew.
I guess that's good enough for a warm-up.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Cheers
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Dober-senpai, you're so cool~~!!
Awesome as always today!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Standing next to Bright-senpai is truly divine...
I'm so blessed this morning...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Senpa~i, do your be~st!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Senpa~~~~i!!!!
choice_data_list: Dober has really changed, hasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? You think so?
choice_data_list: I've gotten to where being watched doesn't faze me anymore.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, come to think of it...
When I first met Trainer,
I used to avoid eye contact, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Somehow... it feels nostalgic.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hmm. I don't think that's what changed the most, though~...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wait, there's something else?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Have you really not realized it yourself~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Compared to three years ago, Dober is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: "I've become sooooo very obedient to you, Trainer dear~♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...!!
Wh-What are you talking about!?
That's totally not true, right!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on...!
Saying it like that is super embarrassing...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's not like I... f-from the very beginning—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: It's not like I... f-from the very beginning—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! That's not what I meant!
It's not like I was thinking anything from the start,
no, nothing like that—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I just............
trusted you, normally............

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Nobody said anything, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My, oh my~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how scary, how scary~♪
I'll just go on ahead and run, then~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Seriously, Bright, what are you saying...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... I really can't compete with Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you, um, understand too, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Compared to three years ago...
it can't be helped, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Because—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Because you're you.
